name: ramify
description: Lean proofs-as-trees visualizer and editor that lives in the infoview

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Ramify does not run code from the workspace, but it acts on files and settings on your behalf: it reads and writes request files in ~/.proof-tree-companion, opens files, applies the edits you make from the tree, changes your user-level editor settings while the lens is open, and — only if you turn the narration or rewrite-suggestion settings on and store an API key — sends proof text to the Anthropic API. A workspace's own settings can switch the model features on, but they do nothing without an API key that you stored yourself.

enumDescriptions: Comments: show · Context: used · Brief: off · Lints: on · Hypothesis origins: on · Automation trace: opens by itself for the step under the cursor · Tactic hover bar: default, plus ⁇ · Replace with automation (⇓): not offered
Comments: show · Context: used · Brief: off · Lints: on · Hypothesis origins: off · Automation trace: on click · Tactic hover bar: default · Replace with automation (⇓): offered
Comments: show · Context: used · Brief: off · Lints: off · Hypothesis origins: off · Automation trace: on click · Tactic hover bar: default · Replace with automation (⇓): offered
ramify.experience.markdownDescription: How much the proof tree explains itself. A preset: it only fills the defaults of the tree's reading options (the hover bar's buttons where `ramify.hoverBar.*` is not set, the automation trace, and `Comments`, `Context`, `lints`, `brief`, `hypothesis origins` where `ramify.view.*` / `ramify.reading.*` are not set) — a setting you set wins, and anything you switch in the tree itself is written to its setting. Also: `Ramify: Set experience level`.

enumDescriptions: VS Code's own look: codicons, the editor's hover, menu and notification colours, a squiggle under a line with a problem, fold chevrons, a ⋯ chip on a skipped run
Ramify's classic skin: drawn glyphs, a coloured ribbon down a box with a problem, the corner − and +N, the slanted break on a skipped run, § on the author's own cuts
ramify.appearance.markdownDescription: How the proof tree and its chrome are drawn. Paint only: the tree's layout is the same in both. The Layout panel's `classic look` row writes this setting.

enumDescriptions: outline — a compact outline, every node on its own line off a left trunk
spine — goals stacked tight on the left, each tactic beside its step in a right-hand track
tracks — the spine with goals wrapped to a modest width, so tactics and goals read as two columns
wide — a wide layered tree, nodes at the same depth share one horizontal band
ramify.view.layout.markdownDescription: The proof tree's layout (the band's `Layout`). The band's `Layout` panel writes this setting (to where its value already lives — the folder, the workspace, else your user settings).

ramify.view.sideBySide.markdownDescription: Draw a split's subtrees as columns, in the compact layouts (the `Layout` panel's `side-by-side` row, which writes this setting).

ramify.view.gallery.markdownDescription: Show one subtree of a split at a time, with a pager (the `Layout` panel's `gallery` row, which writes this setting).

ramify.view.width.markdownDescription: How wide a node's text may run before it wraps: `"full"` (no wrapping) or a column budget from `20` to `100` (the `Layout` panel's `width` slider, which writes this setting once you let go).

enumDescriptions: used — only hypotheses the rest of the proof below actually uses
intro — only hypotheses the preceding tactic introduced as a binding
diff — hypotheses this goal introduced, plus any its tactic uses
all — every hypothesis in scope
ramify.view.context.markdownDescription: Which hypotheses a goal shows (the band's `Context`). Unset: follows `ramify.experience`. The band's `Context` panel writes this setting (to where its value already lives — the folder, the workspace, else your user settings).

ramify.view.hypGroup.markdownDescription: Draw each goal's context as data first, then propositions, with a divider, instead of Lean's own binder order (the `Context` panel's `split data & props` row, which writes this setting).

enumDescriptions: show — comments drawn as strips above the box
hide — no comment strips; the room goes back to the tree
in place — a commented tactic's prose stands in for its label, inside the box
narrate — strips as above, and where the author wrote none a line generated from the step itself (∴)
ramify.view.comments.markdownDescription: How the proof's comments are drawn (the band's `Comments`: show · hide · in place · narrate). Unset: follows `ramify.experience`. The band's `Comments` panel writes this setting (to where its value already lives — the folder, the workspace, else your user settings).

ramify.reading.brief.markdownDescription: The `brief` reading option: hide boilerplate inside each tactic's own text. Unset: follows `ramify.experience`. The `Reading` panel's row writes this setting.

ramify.reading.merge.markdownDescription: The `merge` reading option: one node per straight run of tactics. The `Reading` panel's row writes this setting.

ramify.reading.lints.markdownDescription: The `lints` reading option: show Mathlib's own style linters on the steps they object to (the declaration is re-elaborated once to ask). Unset: follows `ramify.experience`. The `Reading` panel's row writes this setting.

ramify.reading.hypOrigins.markdownDescription: The `hypothesis origins` reading option: hovering a context line points at the step that introduced it. Unset: follows `ramify.experience`. The `Reading` panel's row writes this setting.

ramify.reading.upToCursor.markdownDescription: The `up to cursor` reading option: draw the proof only down to the editor cursor. The `Reading` panel's row writes this setting.

ramify.diagnostics.autoOpen.markdownDescription: A new error opens the message strip above the tree's band by itself; off, only the problems count opens it (warnings and lints never open it by themselves). The `Reading` panel's `errors open the message strip` row writes this setting.

enumDescriptions: » Show in source
◌ Skip this step while reading (where it has one continuation or is a leaf)
⊹ Show only the path from the root to here
Lightbulb: the fixes and refactorings for the box (opens `⋯` at its Quick Fix and Refactor sections; greyed where there are none)
Delete (trash can; arms first, then writes)
⁇ What did the automation (`simp`, `grind`, `aesop`…) use?
⇓ Replace a closing run of steps with one automation tactic
⇑ Write out what the automation used
⤵ Move a single-use `have` into its one use
⤴ Pull a `(by …)` block out as a `have`
✎ Apply the linter's fix
⧉ Open the tactic to the side (the lens, a slim editor below the infoview)
+ Show the goal a calc/constructor step proves

ramify.hoverBar.tactic.markdownDescription: The buttons on the hover bar of a **tactic** box, left to right, each drawn only where the move is available on that box. `⋯` (every move on the box, with what each icon means and a pin to put it on the bar) is always last and is not listed. Pinning in `⋯` writes this setting. Unset, the `ramify.experience` preset decides (beginner also shows `⁇`). The automation and restructuring moves (`⇓ ⇑ ⤵ ⤴ ✎`) sit behind `fix`, the lightbulb, unless pinned here.

enumDescriptions: » Show in source
◎ Focus on this goal's subtree (or back to the whole proof)
⊹ Show only the path from the root to here
Lightbulb: the fixes and refactorings for the box (opens `⋯` at its Quick Fix and Refactor sections; greyed where there are none)
Delete (trash can; arms first, then writes)
⇓ Replace a closing run of steps with one automation tactic
✎ Apply the linter's fix

ramify.hoverBar.goal.markdownDescription: The buttons on the hover bar of a **goal** box, left to right, each drawn only where the move is available on that box. `⋯` (every move on the box, with what each icon means and a pin to put it on the bar) is always last and is not listed. Pinning in `⋯` writes this setting. Unset, the `ramify.experience` preset decides.

ramify.outlineOnly.markdownDescription: Draw the tree's node boxes as borders with no fill, only showing the colored outline. Purely cosmetic.

ramify.linkMarks.markdownDescription: Draw the connectors' node-type marks: a dot near either end of a line for goals, a dash for tactics. Off by default.

ramify.linkTint.markdownDescription: Tint each connector based on the colour of the node it terminates at (blue for goals, green for tactics).

ramify.lensGoals.markdownDescription: Show each tactic's resulting goal inline after the tactic line. Drawn as decoration text.

ramify.lensWordWrap.markdownDescription: Wrap long lines in the lens. Does not affect other editors or windows. Skipped when you already wrap globally.

ramify.lensHideChrome.markdownDescription: Hide editor tabs, breadcrumbs, the minimap and sticky scroll while the lens is open, so the small lens editor is mostly code. Ramify remembers the values it changes and restores them when the lens closes, and on the next start if VS Code quit with the lens open. These are user-level settings, so while the lens is open they change in every window. Turn this off to leave them alone.

ramify.counterfactual.markdownDescription: While you are typing a tactic and the proof doesn't elaborate (e.g. because it has errors), show the tree as if the line you are writing were `sorry` so the tree keeps its full shape, replaced with the real tree when the proof is fixed. Costs one Lean re-check of the current theorem per edited line (cached).

ramify.hypMarkStyle.markdownDescription: How the tree marks the hypotheses a tactic uses when you hover its box.

ramify.narration.polish.markdownDescription: In `Comments: narrate`, send each generated line to a model to be rewritten as fluent English (shown with `≈` instead of `∴`). The rewrite is constrained: it keeps every symbol and name, adds no facts, and never sees anything you wrote yourself — your own comments are not sent. Needs an API key (`Ramify: Set model API key`). Off by default; the tree's own templated narration needs nothing.

ramify.narration.model.markdownDescription: The model that does the rewriting. Polish is a rewriting task, not a reasoning one, so the cheap model is the default.

ramify.restructure.propose.markdownDescription: Let `suggest a rewrite` (in the tree's reading options) ask a model to pick one of the restructurings the tree already offers, with a one-line reason. The model chooses among offered moves and never writes text; whatever it picks is still checked by Lean before you are offered it. Needs an API key (`Ramify: Set model API key`). Off by default.

ramify.restructure.renameAfterHoist.markdownDescription: After you accept an **extract** (the tree's `⤴`, which hoists a `(by …)` into `have this : … := by …`), open the editor's own **Rename Symbol** on the new `this`, so you can type the name you want. Lean renames the binder and every use; press Esc to keep `this`.

ramify.typingHoldMs.markdownDescription: How long (in milliseconds) the cursor must sit still after you type before the tree redraws to match the changed proof. Prevents redraw after every keystroke. Raise it if you type slowly and still see churn mid-edit; `0` redraws on every change. Edits made from the tree always redraw ASAP.
